title: Grapefruit Pan-Seared Pork Chops
description: A sweet and savory dish featuring pan-seared pork chops with a grapefruit glaze. Perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: 1. Season the pork chops with salt and pepper.
2. Heat the butter in a skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Sear the pork chops for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned.
4. In a small bowl, whisk together the grapefruit juice and brown sugar.
5. Brush the grapefruit glaze over the pork chops during the last minute of cooking.
6. Remove the pork chops from the skillet and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
